name: Manganic-Scree
description: Sand owns this world, in colors from bone-white to burnt sienna, migrating with the seasons before a patient wind. Where the gusts strip it away, solar wind erosion patterns emerge like the bones of the planet.
Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound.

The colonists of the monolithic structures of unknown origin kept meticulous logs right up to the final entry, which is a shopping list. Rescue charters still quote the coordinates, and still decline the contract.
The next expedition is already fitting out. Whether it returns with data, ore, or just debts depends on choices nobody has made yet.
